rationale: Price ($384.93) remains above session VWAP ($382.61) and in the upper 73% of today's range, so the core long structure is intact; the dip to $384.21 was bought back and the last candle closed near its high, suggesting the pullback below the 5m 9-EMA ($385.05) is a retest rather than a breakdown.
